evidence: tests.yml carried an inline github-script isDocumentation/frontend classifier while scripts/pr_policy.py carried an independent RISK_PATTERNS list. Nothing asserted they agreed, so required CI job selection and the sensitive-scope trust gate could silently diverge.
impact: A drift between the two would let a PR run the wrong required jobs while the trust gate classified it differently, with no failing test.
promotion_reason: single non-critical observation; collect another occurrence
suggested_change: Resolved in PR #606: scripts/pr_scope.py is now the single classifier, pr_policy.py imports its patterns, and the classifier is itself sensitive scope. Keep the binding assertion in place.
summary: Change-scope logic existed twice with no test binding the two copies together.
verified_by: tests/test_pr_scope.py::test_policy_and_ci_read_one_pattern_source and tests/test_ci_gate_workflows.py::test_change_scope_comes_from_the_canonical_classifier, both green on merged head.
